obligations.title: Last day to send a non-renewal notice
obligations.interpretation: The Subscription Period ends on each anniversary of the Order Date. 'At least 30 days before' is counted in calendar days, so the last safe day is 30 days before that anniversary. If no notice is sent, the order renews for another 12 months.

obligations.interpretation: Assumes each renewal invoice is dated on the anniversary of the Order Date. Due date is the invoice date plus 30 calendar days.

obligations.title: Report a loss of functionality within 45 days
